heroBody: The Dyson V15 Detect and Dyson V12 Detect Slim look similar in a product card, but they solve different Singapore cleaning problems. The V15 is the stronger full-size option for larger condos, pets, rugs and weekend deep cleans. The V12 is the lighter daily-clean option for HDB flats, tight storerooms and anyone who wants a cordless vacuum they can grab with one hand after dinner. Singapore shoppers also need to check warranty source carefully: Dyson Singapore, authorised retailers and official marketplace stores are safer for local support, while parallel-import listings can look attractive until a battery, charger or motorised head needs servicing. This page pulls live Singapore listings from BuyWhere's catalog so you can compare the current floor across V15 and V12 listings, then use the guide below to decide whether power, weight or warranty should lead your decision.

highlightSectionTitle: The real-world difference between the V15 and V12

highlights.title: Weight matters more in small flats
highlights.body: In a compact HDB flat, you are more likely to use a vacuum for five-minute crumbs, hair and dust trails than for a single long Saturday clean. The V12's lighter body makes that behaviour easier: it is less tiring for ceiling corners, fan blades, sofa gaps and quick kitchen passes. The V15 still cleans brilliantly, but it feels like a bigger tool, so some owners leave it docked until the mess is obvious. If you already avoid heavy appliances, do not ignore the handling difference just because the V15 has the stronger spec sheet.

highlights.title: The V15 earns its keep with pets and rugs
highlights.body: Singapore homes with a shedding dog, long-haired cat, fabric sofa or medium-pile rug are where the V15 makes sense. The stronger motor and larger bin mean fewer repeat passes and fewer interruptions to empty dust and hair. On hard tiles with no pets, the advantage narrows; both models pick up visible grit quickly, and the V12's convenience may matter more than peak suction. The question is not which Dyson is better in a lab, but which one removes your actual mess with the least friction.

highlights.title: Local warranty is part of the price
highlights.body: Dyson cordless vacuums have expensive consumables and motorised heads, so the cheapest Singapore listing is not automatically the best buy. Local sets from Dyson Singapore, authorised retailers and official marketplace stores are easier to service and verify. Parallel imports can be fine for confident bargain hunters, but check the charger plug, included heads, battery support and whether the seller handles warranty in Singapore. A cheap listing with missing accessories can cost more than a slightly higher local bundle.

highlights.title: Campaign timing changes the recommendation
highlights.body: The V12 is usually the value pick when both models sit near normal retail pricing, but Shopee, Lazada and Dyson direct campaigns can briefly make the V15 much more tempting. Compare the live product cards during 9.9, 10.10, 11.11, 12.12 and payday sales, then read the seller notes before checking out. A discounted official V15 bundle can beat a bare V12 if you need the extra floor head, while a clean V12 local-set deal is hard to beat for apartments.

adviceSectionTitle: Which Dyson should Singapore buyers choose?
advicePoints: Buy the V15 if you have pets, rugs, a larger condo or a habit of doing one deep clean each week. The extra power and larger bin reduce interruptions and make stubborn hair easier to remove.
Buy the V12 if you live in an HDB flat, clean mostly tile or vinyl floors, and want a vacuum that feels light enough for quick daily use. Convenience beats raw power for many Singapore homes.
Treat warranty as part of the total cost. For a V15, local Dyson Singapore coverage is worth paying attention to because replacement heads and batteries are expensive.
Do not compare only the headline model name. Dyson bundles differ by floor head, crevice tools, stands and filters, so a cheaper listing can be worse value if it ships as a stripped kit.

Avoid accessory floods in marketplace search results. Filters, batteries, stands and replacement heads can look like Dyson bargains but are not vacuum listings; use the live cards here to stay on full-unit products.
If you already own a working V11 or recent V12, upgrade only if you specifically need the laser dust head, lighter handling or better pet-hair performance. Otherwise, wait for a campaign bundle.
faqSectionTitle: Dyson V15 vs V12 in Singapore — common questions

faqs.question: Is the Dyson V15 worth it over the V12 in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Yes if you have pets, rugs or a larger home where stronger suction and a bigger bin save time every clean. No if you live in a smaller flat with mostly hard floors; the V12 is easier to handle and usually the more sensible daily-clean vacuum.

faqs.question: Which Dyson is better for HDB flats?
faqs.answer: The V12 is usually better for HDB flats because it is lighter, easier to store and less tiring for quick daily cleaning. Choose the V15 only if your flat has pets, thick rugs or heavy dust loads that justify the bigger machine.

faqs.question: Should I buy a parallel-import Dyson V15 or V12 in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Only if the seller warranty, plug type, included accessories and return terms are clear. Local Dyson Singapore or authorised stock is safer, especially for the V15, because batteries and motorised floor heads are expensive if support becomes difficult.

faqs.question: When are Dyson V15 and V12 prices lowest in Singapore?
faqs.answer: The best windows are usually major marketplace campaigns such as 9.9, 10.10, 11.11, 12.12 and payday sales, plus Dyson direct bundle periods. The live cards on this page show the current floor without relying on stale sale snapshots.

faqs.question: Do the V15 and V12 use the same Dyson accessories?
faqs.answer: Many modern Dyson stick-vacuum tools are cross-compatible, but bundle contents vary by SKU and region. Check the exact floor head, charger, stand and small tools in the seller listing before assuming two similarly named products include the same kit.

categoryIntro.heading: Why Singapore Dyson comparisons need live prices
categoryIntro.body: Dyson pricing in Singapore moves with platform campaigns, bundle rotations and seller mix. The same model can appear as an official local set, an authorised-retailer bundle, a LazMall or Shopee Mall campaign listing, or a parallel import with different accessories. That makes a static V15 vs V12 recommendation incomplete: the V12 may be the obvious apartment pick at normal pricing, but a strong V15 bundle can become the better buy for pet homes during a campaign.
